items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Hilda is mentioned by the interviewer as a daughter of Spencer Johnson; the interviewee does not mention Hilda directly or describe a personal interaction.

ctx.x: Spencer Johnson; he had a son who was a musician also, Carl. The daughters were schoolteachers; Hilda, Gloria and one other daughter. He was the president prior to Mr. Bailey.
